verzen.tekst: And Tobit wrote a prayer for rejoicing, and said,
verzen.html: And Tobit wrote a prayer for rejoicing, and said,

verzen.tekst: For he scourges, and shows mercy.
verzen.html: For he scourges, and shows mercy.

verzen.tekst: Give thanks to him before the Gentiles, all you children of Israel!
verzen.html: Give thanks to him before the Gentiles, all you children of Israel!

verzen.tekst: He will scourge us for our iniquities, and will again show mercy,
verzen.html: He will scourge us for our iniquities, and will again show mercy,

verzen.tekst: If you turn to him with your whole heart and with your whole soul,
verzen.html: If you turn to him with your whole heart and with your whole soul,

verzen.tekst: Give thanks to the Lord with goodness,
verzen.html: Give thanks to the Lord with goodness,

verzen.tekst: Many nations will come from afar to the name of the Lord God
verzen.html: Many nations will come from afar to the name of the Lord God

verzen.tekst: All those who hate you are cursed.
verzen.html: All those who hate you are cursed.

verzen.tekst: Rejoice and be exceedingly glad for the sons of the righteous;
verzen.html: Rejoice and be exceedingly glad for the sons of the righteous;

verzen.tekst: Oh blessed are those who love you.
verzen.html: Oh blessed are those who love you.

verzen.tekst: Let my soul bless God the great King.
verzen.html: Let my soul bless God the great King.

verzen.tekst: For Jerusalem will be built with sapphires, emeralds, and precious stones;
verzen.html: For Jerusalem will be built with sapphires, emeralds, and precious stones;

verzen.tekst: The streets of Jerusalem will be paved with beryl, carbuncle, and stones of Ophir.
verzen.html: The streets of Jerusalem will be paved with beryl, carbuncle, and stones of Ophir.
